in_marathi.name: Prabhanjan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who can tame or destroy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prabhanjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prabhanjan is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Prabh' which means 'to tame'. The suffix 'anjan' means 'destroyer'. This name signifies a person who can tame and destroy. It represents power, courage and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is known as Prabhanjan because he can tame and destroy the negative energies.
